html: III. רעה (Aramaic רְעָא ܪܥܶܐ, take pleasure (in), desire, = Arabic رضى [Heb. רָצָה], whence Aramaic רְעוּתָא desire, רַעֲיָנָא, רַעֲיוֹנָא, ܪܶܥܝܳܢܳܐ opinion, thought, disposition, and following late and Aramaic words in Heb., cf. NöZMG liv (1900), 155; > De Siegf Qoh. 18 al. from I. רעה 2 b, cf. Ho 12:2, and Arabic رَعَى watch, regard, respect (Lane) [BaWU 46 f. Kau Aramaismen 82 f. deriv foll. from I. רעה = observe, attend to, specif. tend sheep, also aim at, purpose]).
